copy.headline: Cowboys strip play-calling duties from defensive coordinator Christian Parker
copy.caption: Cowboys owner and GM Jerry Jones hinted at a change earlier this week. Reporter Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News joins NBC 5 Sports Director Newy Scruggs to break down the Cowboys’ uncertain future for defensive coordinator Christian Parker.

story.title: Cowboys strip play-calling duties from defensive coordinator Christian Parker
story.summary: Cowboys owner and GM Jerry Jones hinted at a change earlier this week. Reporter Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News joins NBC 5 Sports Director Newy Scruggs to break down the Cowboys’ uncertain future for defensive coordinator Christian Parker. The Cowboys are taking play-calling duties away from first-time defensive coordinator Christian Parker after Dallas gave up three long touchdowns and the most yards at home in franchise history during a loss to San Francisco, two people with knowledge of the decision said Wednesday. Parker will retain his title, but former NFL defensive coordinator Mike Pettine, who joined the staff a month ago, will call the plays, the people told The Associated Press on condition of anonymity because the move hasn't been announced.
